from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import sys
import zipfile

source=Path('WORK/checks/tooling/replay_review_return.py').resolve()
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('replay_archive_validation',source)
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
original=Path('/workspace/scratch/575c2059d357/upload/SEND-THIS-ARCpuzzles-review(20261019-054730).zip')
parent=Path('/dev/shm')
report={'schema':'arcpuzzles-issued-zip-validation-v1','status':'failed','extraction_performed':False,
        'helper_sha256':module.file_sha256(source),'original_zip':str(original),
        'original_zip_sha256':module.file_sha256(original),'destination_parent':str(parent),
        'allow_case_distinct_paths':True,'expected_regular_members':74827}
try:
    report['destination_case_sensitive']=module.destination_case_sensitive(parent)
    if not report['destination_case_sensitive']:
        raise module.ReplayError('Case-distinct ZIP paths require a case-sensitive destination parent')
    with zipfile.ZipFile(original) as archive:
        infos=module.validate_zip(archive,kind='original',allow_case_distinct_paths=True)
        regular=[info for info in infos if not info.is_dir()]
        aliases={}
        for info in infos:
            name=info.filename.rstrip('/')
            aliases.setdefault(name.casefold(),[]).append(name)
        report.update(member_count=len(infos),regular_member_count=len(regular),
                      directory_member_count=len(infos)-len(regular),
                      expanded_bytes=sum(info.file_size for info in infos),
                      expected_regular_members_match=len(regular)==74827,
                      case_distinct_member_groups=[names for names in aliases.values() if len(names)>1],
                      status='passed')
except (ValueError,OSError,zipfile.BadZipFile) as exc:
    report['error']=str(exc)
report['exit_code']=0 if report['status']=='passed' else 2
Path('WORK/checks/tooling/original-zip-validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True))
sys.exit(report['exit_code'])
PY
